<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex15012024-11-08-11-292" status="finalized">
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre chen po</rs> na re yum sras yin pas rgyu 'bras su mi 'gyur ste rnam par bzhag 'jog gi yum sras yin pa'i phyir ba glang dang nog lkog shal <abbr>bzhin</abbr> no || 
             'di ltar gzhi shes rnaM 'jog rgyu nyan rang 'phags pa rnam
         <pb n="12b"/>
            <lb n="12b1"/> bzhag 'bras bu | lam shes rnam 'jog rgyu byang chub <abbr>sems dpa'</abbr> rnam bzhag 'bras bu | rnam mkhyen rnam 'jog rgyu <abbr>sangs rgyas</abbr> rnaM bzhag 'bras bu yin ste | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5633">mdo</rs> las ko'u shi ka nga'i dngos po'i sku 'di mnyes pas ni de <abbr>bzhin</abbr> gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su mi 'gro yis | rnam pa <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen pa nyid mnyes pas ni de <abbr>bzhin</abbr> gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs
            <lb n="12b2"/> su 'gro'o zhes gsungs pa dang | </seg></TEI>
